question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping faces no evident pressure to exit leadership before 2027, as recent developments underscore his firm control ahead of the 21st Party Congress scheduled for late 2027. Ongoing purges of Central Committee and military figures, including expected expulsions at the October 2026 Fifth Plenary Session, reflect continued consolidation rather than vulnerability, while loyalists such as Cai Qi assume expanded roles in cadre training and security. At age 73, Xi has shown no public signs of health decline or intent to step aside, and the absence of a designated successor aligns with patterns of extended tenure following the removal of term limits. Trader consensus at 96% for "No" rests on this institutional stability and lack of disruptive events. Realistic shifts remain possible only through unforeseen developments such as acute medical issues, an unprecedented internal challenge, or abrupt policy reversals that erode elite support before year-end.
